questions.question: Why does `EmployeeService` store its list with `signal<Employee[]>([...])` instead of a plain array property?
options: Signals are required for HttpClient to work
So every component reading `employees.all` re-renders automatically when the list changes, without manual change detection calls
Plain arrays can't be typed in TypeScript
It has no practical benefit over a plain array
questions.explanation: Wrapping the list in a signal makes it reactive — any component reading it via the readonly `all` accessor updates automatically when `add()` changes the underlying data.

questions.question: In `EmployeeDetailComponent`, how does the component know which employee to display?
options: It fetches all employees and picks the first one
It reads the `:id` route param via `ActivatedRoute` and looks it up through the injected `EmployeeService`
The parent component passes it as a hardcoded @Input()
It's stored in a global variable
questions.explanation: The route config maps `employees/:id` to this component, and `route.snapshot.paramMap.get('id')` combined with `service.getById()` resolves which employee to show.

questions.question: What does the `filtered` computed signal in `EmployeeListComponent` depend on?
options: Only the search FormControl's current value
Both the service's `employees` signal and the search FormControl's value
questions.explanation: `filtered` reads both `this.employees()` (the signal) and `this.search.value` inside its computation, combining service state with local search input.

questions.question: Why is the add-employee form disabled from submitting when invalid (`[disabled]="form.invalid"`)?
options: Angular forms are always disabled by default
The reactive form's required validators mean `form.invalid` is true until name, role, and department are all filled in
It's disabled permanently until an admin approves it
This has no relation to the form's validators
questions.explanation: Each field has `Validators.required`, so the FormGroup as a whole is invalid until every required field has a value, and the submit button reflects that via the disabled binding.
